source: User screenshots and explicit confirmations in this chat, 2026-11-04
assumptions: Captured account and lineup modifiers are already included; values stay fixed as the roster changes.
No additional GM, event, raw Skill Power or map mastery scaling is applied to the captured skill bonuses.
One Damage tile is modeled, and a hero occupies one tile.
Warden uses the observed +180,249% mastery damage at 10.7m. Other distances scale proportionally; rounded per-step and distance labels do not reconstruct the current-bonus display exactly.
Dicemaster non-maximum rolls are assumed uniform within the displayed ranges; expected chances are exact for the current linear chance spillover formula.
Mastery maximum-roll probability is capped at 100%.

At the time of this capture, the single-target index used an additional splash multiplier and excluded extra multishot targets, range, base attack speed, attack speed caps, base damage and skill uptime.
supportUpdate: See support-skills.json and melee-9gm.json for the revised single-target splash rule. Templar’s active splash, stacked splash and Warlord’s personal splash add to one total for ordinary attacks.
